S01.headline: Your attention is yours to spend.
S01.sub: LookUp helps you use social media on your own terms — from the first honest look at a week, to the pull that arrives at 11pm on a Tuesday.

blocks.title: Private by default
blocks.body: Nothing leaves your phone unless you choose to send it.

blocks.title: Help when the pull hits
blocks.body: One tap, ninety seconds, works offline.

blocks.title: A slip never resets you
blocks.body: Progress is kept as history, not a streak to lose.

S01.footer: Education and self-management support. Not a diagnosis or treatment.

S03.title: Consent & privacy
S03.headline: What we hold, and what we don't.

blocks.title: Held on your phone
blocks.body: Which apps you picked, your notes, your urge tags. These stay local.

blocks.title: Shared with your care team
blocks.body: Totals and adherence only. Never who you follow, message, or watch.

blocks.title: You can leave
blocks.body: Export or delete everything at any point. Deletion is completed, not hidden.

items.title: Share optional notes with my coach

S03.footer: You can change either choice later in Settings.

S05.title: Baseline week
S05.headline: Just live normally.
S05.sub: Nothing is blocked this week. Without a starting line, neither of us can tell whether anything worked.

blocks.title: Busiest stretch
blocks.body: 21:30 – 23:00, every night so far.

blocks.title: You can stop waiting
blocks.body: Start blocking now if you'd rather. We'll note the baseline is partial.

S07.title: Choose your path
S07.headline: Cut back, or step away?
S07.sub: Neither is the better answer. You can switch later without losing anything.

items.title: Reduce gradually
items.body: Keep social media, shrink it. Most people start here.

items.title: Set a step-away date
items.body: A clean break from chosen apps, with a date you pick.

items.title: Help me decide
items.body: Review both against your baseline, no pressure.

blocks.body: Under 18, LookUp keeps at least 30 minutes a day available. Being cut off from friends is its own harm.

S08.title: Set your limits
S08.headline: What feels doable?
S08.sub: Based on your 4h 12m baseline. An estimate is enough.

blocks.title: Times you open them
blocks.body: Sixty two-minute checks fragments a day more than one long sitting.

blocks.title: Quiet hours
blocks.body: 22:30 – 06:30, every night

S08.footer: You can change these later — increases wait 24 hours.

S09.title: My reasons
S09.headline: Why does this matter to you?
S09.sub: We'll show these back at the moments that are hardest. Your words work better than ours.
S09.footer: Kept on your phone. Not shared with anyone.

SH1.title: Your programs
SH1.headline: Two at a time, at most.
SH1.sub: Three concurrent changes is where most people stall. A third needs a conversation, not a tap.

blocks.title: LookUp
blocks.body: Digital wellbeing · 2h 21m average day

blocks.title: BreatheFree
blocks.body: Tobacco & nicotine · 19 days smoke-free

items: Healthy weight · resumes when you say so

blocks.title: Hidden from your home screen
blocks.body: BreatheFree is reachable only from here. Nothing shows on your lock screen.

SH1.footer: Each program shares separately. Nothing is pooled.

SH2.title: Health areas
SH2.headline: What Tether covers, and what exists yet.
SH2.sub: One area has code being written. The rest are a plan. Where a line sounds like something you could use now, it is not.

blocks.title: Tobacco & nicotine
blocks.body: Cigarettes, vaping, smokeless tobacco · 4 service lines

blocks.title: Digital wellbeing
blocks.body: Compulsive social media use, screen overuse, sleep disruption
Planned areas have no implementation. We will tell you when that changes, and not before.

SH2.footer: Nothing here is a diagnosis or a recommendation to enrol.

SH3.title: Digital wellbeing
SH3.headline: What joining changes.
SH3.sub: Read this before you decide. You can leave at any point and take your data with you.

blocks.title: What it does
blocks.body: Limits you set, a pause before chosen apps open, urge tools that work offline, and check-ins under ninety seconds.

blocks.title: What it needs
blocks.body: Permission to see time on the apps you pick, and to shield them. You choose the apps — we never read who you follow or message.

blocks.title: What your coach would see
blocks.body: Totals and adherence for this program only. Not your BreatheFree data, not your notes.

blocks.title: You already have two active
blocks.body: Joining this would pause Healthy weight. You can switch back whenever you want.
Education and self-management support. It does not diagnose, treat or prescribe, and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified health professional.

SH3.footer: Joining asks for consent separately, in plain language.

SH4.title: Your record
SH4.headline: Everything, in one place.
SH4.sub: Across every program you have joined. Yours to export or delete.

items: Check-ins, cravings, quit plan, one slip

blocks.title: Export everything
blocks.body: A readable file plus a structured one. Includes paused and ended programs.

blocks.title: Delete everything
blocks.body: Completed, not hidden. This cannot be undone, and it ends every active program.

SH4.footer: Deletion clears your phone, our servers and anything queued to sync.

SH5.title: Who sees what
SH5.headline: Sharing is set per program.
SH5.sub: Nothing is pooled between them, and nothing is shared by default.

items: Monthly summary · you approve each send

blocks.title: Why they are separate
blocks.body: A cessation coach has no reason to see behavioural health data. Some categories are legally required to stay segregated.

blocks.title: Preview before sending
blocks.body: Every share shows you the exact contents first. You can cancel at that point.

SH5.footer: Changing a setting here affects one program only.
